text: Starts fast and rarely buffers · adaptive bitrate, captions, resume on any device
originalText: Starts fast and rarely buffers · adaptive bitrate, captions, resume on any device

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- HLS/DASH with ABR: pick bitrate from
  throughput + buffer level
- Short startup: low first rendition,
  preload manifest, preconnect to CDN
- Captions (WebVTT), keyboard controls,
  focus visible, reduced motion
- Resume via progress beacons
- QoE: startup, rebuffer ratio, bitrate
